title: You became a mirror they hate looking into. 🪞💔
paragraphs: You became a mirror they hate looking into. 🪞💔
"People love your faith until your faith exposes their laziness, their excuses, their masks."

They applaud your testimony when it’s about blessings, but they resent your lifestyle when it’s about boundaries. Why? Because your obedience highlights their compromise. Your fire highlights their lukewarmness.

Don't dim your light just because it hurts their eyes. If your walk with God makes them uncomfortable, it’s not because you’re judging them—it’s because your life is convicting them without you saying a word.
📖 "Everyone who does evil hates the light, and will not come into the light for fear that their deeds will be exposed." — John 3:20
Drop a 🔦 if you refuse to dim your light! ⚔️ Follow @iamGospelWarrior regarding the truth.
